BackstoryDef.title: combine worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Factories never stopped after the Seven Hour War. [PAWN_nameDef] was given a mask, a wrench, and a quota. Keeping Combine technology humming bought a few extra ration points, and slowly bought their silence.

BackstoryDef.title: combine worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: After the occupation, [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to fix and maintain equipment and machinery. The work was technical and thankness, but it paid.

BackstoryDef.title: combine worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] signed on as reconstruction labor, then learned the fine print: relocation, indoctrination, and a collar code that followed them everywhere. They became efficient at building walls meant to cage the same population they came from.

BackstoryDef.title: combine worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acted as a dangerous field engineer, running cables through ruined basements, swapping power cores, and patching bio-mechanical conduits while alarms wailed overhead. Survival depended on being useful and never asking what the systems were for.

BackstoryDef.title: combine worker
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Captured during a raid, [PAWN_nameDef] was offered a choice between the cells and the tool belt. They chose the tool belt and were marched into maintenance crews under a new serial number.
